description: This file defines data structures, enums, and function prototypes for automation utilities in a C project, including handling automation data, file paths, parsing, writing, disassembling, and assembling automation configurations.

methods.name: getZilkerBasePath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the base zilker repository. Caller should free the returned string.

methods.name: getBaseUtilityPath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the base automation utility tool. Caller should free the returned string.

methods.name: getOutPath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the automation utility out directory. Caller should free the returned string.

methods.name: createAutomation
methods.description: Creates and returns a new automation object.

methods.name: destroyAutomation
methods.description: Destroys and frees resources for a given automation object.

methods.name: parseFileToAutomation
methods.description: Parses a string containing automation file contents into an automation structure. Returns true if successful.

methods.name: writeAutomationToFile
methods.description: Writes an automation structure to a specified file. Returns true if successful.

methods.name: disassembleAndWriteAutomation
methods.description: Disassembles an automation into multiple files in a directory structure.

methods.name: assembleAndWriteAutomation
methods.description: Assembles a disassembled automation from a directory into a single file.
